# JPM — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (April 14) are fully priced — record $16.5B net income, EPS $5.94 vs $5.49 estimate (+8.2%) [run: 20260430_182725]. FOMC held at 3.50%–3.75% on April 29 — third consecutive hold, no surprise [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928]. Iran peace talks progressed on May 1 (WTI −2%) — dominant left-tail risk easing. No actionable catalyst within the 10-trading-day swing window. The next scheduled binary event is **Q2 2026 earnings on July 14, 2026**, consensus EPS $5.36–$5.41 [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].

## Upcoming events

- **Annual shareholder meeting: May 19, 2026.** Dimon to present. No expected surprise — monitoring for NII guidance language [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **Dimon at Bernstein conference: May 27, 2026.** Could yield forward credit-cycle color — watch for headlines [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **Q2 2026 earnings: July 14, 2026.** Consensus Q2 EPS $5.36–$5.41. Full-year 2026 technology spend guided to $19.8B (+10% YoY). Next binary catalyst — 55+ trading days away [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **NII guidance watch:** Guidance trimmed from $104.5B to ~$103B in Q1 2026. Any further reduction is a negative catalyst. Next formal read at Q2 earnings July 14 [run: 20260430_182725].
- **Kevin Warsh Fed transition:** Powell exits as Chair May 15, stays on Board. Warsh succession introduces near-term policy uncertainty — no rate cut signaled [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].

## Recent news synthesis

- **Q1 2026 record earnings (Apr 14, fully priced):** Net income +13% YoY, EPS $5.94 beat $5.49 estimate, revenue $50.54B beat $49.17B, FICC trading revenue +21% to $7.1B, IB fees +18% YoY, AWM AUM $4.8T [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **Dimon bond-crisis warning (May 2026):** CEO warned of 'some kind of bond crisis' ahead as global debt risks build — escalated from prior Apr 28 credit-cycle warning. Bearish headline for credit-sensitive financials [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **JPM prediction market services (2026):** Dimon revealed JPM is considering prediction market services — optionality signal, net positive sentiment [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **JPM raised S&P 500 target to 7,600:** Citing AI momentum and stronger earnings outlook [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **Apple Card acquisition:** $20B Goldman portfolio acquired, adding tech-savvy consumer accounts [run: 20260430_051455].
- **Exec harassment lawsuit (Apr 30):** Senior JPM executive faces lawsuit — reputational risk, immaterial to fundamentals but negative sentiment [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].
- **Iran peace talks (May 1):** WTI −2% on the session — if ceasefire holds, energy-driven inflation eases and H2 2026 Fed cuts become more likely (positive for JPM) [web_research/JPM.json, run 20260501_182928].

## Insider activity

No recent insider trades in the Apr 30 – May 1 data bundle [run: 20260501_182928]. Board directors bought shares in March 2026 — activity quiet since [run: 20260415_093758].
